purpose: HELD same-config replication preparation for KC-S1b. The four composed fragments, frozen DEV-1000 roster, original example-bearing slot-schema fill, predecessor binding, request semantics, model geometry and decoding remain unchanged from SAEA-SLURP-KC-S1B-SLOTS-SCHEMA-DEV1000-V1. This fragment changes only the formal experiment identity and preparation metadata; it authorizes no contact and carries no scientific verdict.

predecessor.binding: sealed-manifest; source manifest bytes are unchanged and are read only as the predecessor state source

runtime_version_bridge_requirement: Root must bind the owner-approved runtime-version bridge before any fit or generation contact: the bridge must identify the same pinned llama.cpp build, runtime receipt and per-file model hashes used by the four fragments, and must be registered in the exposure record. This preparation does not invent or copy source hashes.

execution_plan_basis.generation: 1,000 roster contacts plus 8 canaries; proposal 1,050 calls, 3,000 audio seconds and 1 GPU-hour. The registered exposure row supplies the live ceilings.
execution_plan_basis.fit: The shared fitter's actual endpoint sequence is 1 GET /props + 1,000 POST /apply-template + 2,000 POST /tokenize = 3,001 tokenizer contacts for the complete roster. The fit exposure proposal must therefore use a 3,001 contact cap (with any additional margin separately approved), not the 1,050 generation cap.

readiness.reason: Preparation only. Root must register the generation exposure row and fit exposure row, bind the runtime-version bridge, land the full-roster fit artifact, pass contact-free wire and smoke checks, and obtain owner GO before dispatch.

prompt_fit.scope: Full frozen DEV-1000 roster, same four fragments and same composed configuration as the generation cell; zero generated tokens.
prompt_fit.artifact_binding: The shared fitter artifact_inputs config digest must bind this composed experiment while stripping only readiness and fit receipt self-reference fields. It must bind the same split identity, runtime receipt, required session identity, implementation hashes and request boundary used by generation.
prompt_fit.dispatch_constraint: The current core.flight CLI selects one experiment fragment for a mode globally. It cannot safely dispatch this fit cell as a tokenizer-only preparation and the generation cell as a campaign in one mixed campaign. Root must register and invoke the fit separately while reusing this immutable four-fragment identity, or record an equivalent owner-approved arrangement; no code bypass is added here.
